# P&N Electrical Services

> Trusted local electrician covering the Wirral and surrounding areas of Merseyside. EICR testing, outdoor lighting, rewiring, consumer units and more. Run by Tom, a qualified and fully insured electrician.

## About

P&N Electrical Services is a sole-trader electrical contractor operated by Tom, a qualified electrician based on the Wirral, Merseyside. The business serves domestic homeowners, landlords, and commercial customers across the Wirral peninsula — including Wallasey, Birkenhead, West Kirby, Heswall, Hoylake, Meols, New Brighton, Prenton, Oxton, Rock Ferry and Bebington — as well as surrounding areas of Merseyside.

Tom has hands-on experience across a wide range of domestic and commercial electrical work, from straightforward socket additions to full rewires and 3-phase commercial wiring. The business is fully insured, issues all certificates on the day of inspection, and charges fixed prices with no hidden extras.

P&N Electrical Services also runs a Community Safety Scheme offering free EICR tests to armed forces veterans and elderly residents on the Wirral.

## Services

- **EICR Testing (Electrical Installation Condition Report)** — formal inspection and testing of fixed electrical installations for homeowners and landlords. Certificates issued same day. From £95 for a 1-bedroom property.
- **Outdoor Lighting** — professionally installed driveway, garden, gate pillar and pathway lighting. Before-and-after results across the Wirral.
- **Fuse Boards and Consumer Unit Upgrades** — replacements and upgrades to modern consumer units meeting current BS 7671 regulations.
- **Fault Finding and Repairs** — diagnosis and repair of tripping breakers, power outages, faulty sockets and other electrical faults.
- **Sockets and Rewiring** — additional sockets, USB outlets, partial rewires and full domestic rewires. Tidy, minimal disruption.
- **Landlord Compliance** — EICR certificates, smoke alarm installation, and compliance documentation for rental properties.
- **EV Charger Installation** — domestic and commercial EV charger installation including Hypervolt and other leading brands.
- **3-Phase Wiring** — commercial 3-phase electrical supply and wiring for ramps, machinery and industrial equipment.
- **Smoke Alarm Installation** — mains-wired and interlinked smoke and carbon monoxide alarm systems.
- **Consumer Unit Upgrades** — upgrading older fuse boxes to modern consumer units with RCD protection.
- **Additional Sockets and Circuits** — adding circuits and sockets to meet the demands of modern homes and businesses.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is an EICR?**
An Electrical Installation Condition Report (EICR) is a formal inspection of a property's fixed electrical installation — the wiring, consumer unit, sockets, switches and earthing. It grades the installation from satisfactory to requiring urgent remedial work. Recommended every 10 years for owner-occupiers and every 5 years for rental properties. P&N Electrical Services issues the certificate on the same day as the inspection.

**How much does an EICR cost in Wirral?**
P&N Electrical Services charges from £95 for a 1-bedroom property up to £150 for a 6-bedroom home — fixed prices with no hidden extras. The certificate is issued on the day and the report is written in plain English. Call 07941 061 966 for a free quote.

**Do landlords in England need an EICR?**
Yes. Since 1 April 2021, all landlords in England are legally required to hold a valid EICR renewed at least every 5 years. A copy must be provided to tenants within 28 days of inspection and to the local council on request within 7 days. Failure to comply can result in a civil penalty of up to £30,000.

**Does P&N Electrical Services install EV chargers?**
Yes. Tom installs EV chargers for domestic and commercial customers across the Wirral, including Hypervolt and other leading units. Call 07941 061 966 for a free, no-obligation quote.

**What areas does P&N Electrical Services cover?**
The whole Wirral peninsula and surrounding Merseyside areas — Wallasey, Birkenhead, West Kirby, Heswall, Hoylake, Meols, New Brighton, Prenton, Oxton, Rock Ferry and Bebington. Call 07941 061 966 to confirm availability in your postcode.

**Does P&N Electrical Services offer free quotes?**
Yes. All quotes are free and carry no obligation. Call 07941 061 966 or message via Facebook.

**What is the P&N Community Safety Scheme?**
P&N Electrical Services offers one free EICR to armed forces veterans and one free EICR to elderly residents who need it most. Contact Tom on 07941 061 966 to nominate someone or to find out more.
